evaluation_title: Stage 6 Orthogonal Homoglyph vs Similarity Ablation Study
research_objective: Resolve the Stage 5 evaluation confound where single-character homoglyphs were masked by the SequenceMatcher fallback.

condition_a_homoglyph_only.description: Multi-character homoglyphs where skeleton matches 100% but raw SequenceMatcher similarity is strictly below 0.85.
condition_a_homoglyph_only.component_necessity_finding: The controlled ablation demonstrates that, for the evaluated orthogonal mutation set, homoglyph canonicalization is necessary to detect cases whose lexical similarity falls below the fixed threshold.

condition_b_similarity_only.description: Pure typosquats where similarity is >= 0.85 but skeleton does NOT match.
condition_b_similarity_only.component_necessity_finding: The controlled ablation demonstrates that, for the evaluated non-confusable typosquats, lexical similarity matching is necessary when the canonical skeleton differs.
